messages:
maria: quick sync — console quota page is showing route-level buckets but some traffic is still getting attributed to the 'default' pool. I traced a few requests from the py SDK canary and they have `X-Route` set but the console attribution doesn't match. anyone seen this? :thinking:

jonathan: saw a couple of alerts in staging earlier. reprod steps: hit the /generate route with the new header and look at the console timeline, tokens count goes to default.

sasha: that sounds like the policy router not honoring the header for routed telemetry events. could be the sampling/telemetry shim sitting in front of the console collector.

maria: exactly — seems like the SDK sends header `X-Redwood-Route: beta-affinity` but the proxy strips it when batching. devtool trace shows header present up to the proxy, gone after batching.

ana: (typo — should be ana) Ana: I think this is the batcher rewrite I landed last week. It intentionally normalizes some headers to reduce cardinality; we may have overzealously whitelisted.

jonathan: aha. For an immediate workaround we can have SDK include route metadata in the payload JSON under `meta.route` so the batcher can copy it into telemetry events, then console attribution will be correct. Not ideal but quick.

ryan: can we avoid a payload change? We want backward compat with older servers. SDK change + console normalization would be less invasive.

maria: short-term plan: 1) SDK quick patch to include `meta.route` in POST body (py & ts), 2) Batcher hotfix to preserve `X-Redwood-Route` until routing policy is evaluated, 3) Console update to fallback to `meta.route` if header missing.

sasha: agreed. also need to update the rollout dashboard to show both header and payload-derived attribution until we finish canary. UX should label which source was used.

jonathan: patch for py-sdk ready, will open PR with tests. snippet:

```
# py-sdk client
resp = client.generate(prompt)
# we attach route when available
payload = {"input": prompt, "meta": {"route": client.route_hint}}
```

ana: ana here — I'll revert the normalizer for header keys in the batcher and add a flag `preserve_route_headers` behind a feature flag so we can canary the change.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: batcher-revert-preserve-route-headers -> staging (started) :rocket:

maria: timeline: jonathan PR merges today, ana toggles feature flag in staging, we monitor console attribution for next 24h, then roll to prod if stable. Any objections?

sasha: no objections, but add a console telemetry panel showing dropped vs preserved route headers per minute so we can see the delta.

jonathan: will add tests for header->meta mapping and a small e2e that asserts console attribution matches route hint.

maria: thanks all. I'll file a short postmortem note in the console-ux board and link the PRs. :thumbsup:
